description: This file defines classes related to MPEG tables, specifically Program Association Table (PAT) and Program Map Table (PMT), including iterators for programs and streams, within the Thunder::Broadcast::MPEG namespace.

classes.name: PAT
classes.description: Represents MPEG Program Association Table with nested ProgramIterator class for iterating over programs.

classes.name: PMT
classes.description: Represents MPEG Program Map Table with nested StreamIterator class for iterating over streams.

methods.name: ProgramIterator::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current program iterator position is valid.

methods.name: ProgramIterator::Next
methods.description: Advances the program iterator to the next program.

methods.name: ProgramIterator::ProgramNumber
methods.description: Returns the program number at the current iterator position.

methods.name: ProgramIterator::Pid
methods.description: Returns the PID associated with the current program.

methods.name: StreamIterator::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current stream iterator position is valid.

methods.name: StreamIterator::Next
methods.description: Advances the stream iterator to the next stream.

methods.name: StreamIterator::StreamType
methods.description: Returns the stream type of the current stream.

methods.name: StreamIterator::Pid
methods.description: Returns the PID of the current stream.

methods.name: StreamIterator::Descriptors
methods.description: Returns an iterator over descriptors for the current stream.

methods.name: PMT::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the PMT object is valid.

methods.name: PMT::ProgramNumber
methods.description: Returns the program number associated with the PMT.

methods.name: PMT::PCRPid
methods.description: Returns the PCR PID from the PMT data.

methods.name: PMT::Descriptors
methods.description: Returns an iterator over descriptors in the PMT.

methods.name: PMT::Streams
methods.description: Returns an iterator over streams in the PMT.
